summary: S-001R closes the projection, inferred-field, append-only recovery, and non-zero context-exit findings from D078. It does not close the authority finding. The product automatically writes a raw Ed25519 private JWK into the target repository's local state and ships callable signing code that loads it. An ordinary same-user process in an initialized target independently minted a receipt and published arbitrary canonical direction with exit code 0. Cryptographic integrity is proven; authority separation is not.

d078_finding_disposition.result: Actor-string impersonation is removed, but the replacement capability is worker-readable and therefore forgeable in the normal initialized target model.
The complete normalized projection is compared exactly; duplicate, missing, reordered, extra, and stale content blocks.
Unsupported inferred sections were removed; ordinary worker evidence does not enter canonical status.
Signed reconciliation can reject the exact unresolved malformed-event digest set append-only.
Truth-blocked public context checks return a non-zero process exit.

verification_notes: The supplied native Windows Node v25.2.1 complete-suite evidence is 120 of 120 test files passed. It was not independently rerun because the connector runtime is Node 18.19.1.
Independent focused execution passed 36 truth, readiness, context, custody, and roadmap tests with zero failures.
Independent package dry run reported 239 entries. lib/truth-authority.js and lib/truth-reconciler.js are packaged; repository key files are not packaged.
git diff --check produced only existing line-ending warnings and no whitespace failure.
The load-bearing authority exploit reproduced under connector Node 18.19.1 and does not depend on the supported-runtime difference.
positive_evidence: Receipt bodies bind the exact proposal, prior canonical digest, capability, receipt ID, signer key ID, issue time, and expiry.
Receipt tampering, replay, expiry, wrong-prior binding, public-key removal, and public-key replacement fail closed in the tested paths.
Exact projection comparison removes the duplicate-section and partial-field parser bypasses.
Worker evidence no longer becomes current status truth.
Append-only signed reconciliation closes malformed historical canonical records without editing them.
Truth-blocked context execution now exits non-zero.
The candidate did not claim acceptance, integration, or completion.

findings.title: The signing capability is stored inside the worker-visible target and callable from the shipped product
evidence: lib/truth-authority.js:17-18 places the public key under .meta-harness/contracts and the raw private JWK under .meta-harness/local inside the target root.
lib/truth-authority.js:62-91 automatically generates and writes the private JWK during authority setup.
lib/truth-authority.js:104-111 reads the private JWK from the target root.
lib/truth-authority.js:201-245 exposes a signing function that loads the target-local private key and signs arbitrary proposals.
lib/truth-authority.js:378-397 exports private-key paths, private-key loading, authority setup, and receipt signing from the packaged module.
lib/commands/init.js:37-58 automatically provisions the keypair and self-signs initial canonical truth.

Independent probe initialized a target, read the generated private JWK, called the shipped signer, and event --canonical accepted Worker-authored canonical direction and Unauthorized worker goal with process exit 0.
findings.impact: Any same-user worker or process with ordinary target/package read access can become the canonical controller. The receipt proves possession of a key that the product gives to the worker trust domain; it does not prove human or controller authority.
findings.required_repair: Make the shipped/runtime product verifier-only. Delete target-local private-key generation, storage, loading, and signing APIs with no compatibility path. Canonical init and mutation must consume a public verification key plus externally produced signed receipt from a trust domain unavailable to workers. A test-only signer may exist only under tests and must not read private material from the target.

findings.title: The self-hosted public verification key is not Git-tracked
evidence: The signed D078 event and current status require signer key ID sha256:bbc4330c83fd3b392a2b0628618d34b612818359dec1ea5ed47227f96f11be41.
findings.impact: Another checkout cannot validate the signed canonical history from the current named commit. The candidate is not check-outable or independently reproducible as self-hosted truth.
findings.required_repair: Close under INTEGRATE-S001: track the exact public key and signed event/status candidate together, reconcile upstream, and prove a fresh checkout validates MH_TRUTH_001 without private material.

findings.title: Legitimate future mutation depends on an unproven external copy of the current private capability
evidence: The current public key is pinned by the signed event history and hostile public-key replacement is correctly rejected.
No evidence in the candidate proves that the matching private capability is retained, recoverable, and inaccessible to workers.
findings.impact: The checkout is safely fail-closed, but if the matching private capability is not recoverable, canonical truth is permanently frozen. If it is provisioned back into the target, the critical worker-forgery defect returns.
findings.required_repair: Add a named G-001 authority gate: prove external custody of the current signing capability, produce one bounded receipt without placing private material in the repository or worker environment, and retain recovery evidence. Do not build a key vault, daemon, or provider adapter in this slice.

findings.title: Current tests prove signature integrity but encode the broken authority model
evidence: tests/cli-truth.test.js mints accepted receipts by calling lib/truth-authority createTruthAuthorityReceipt against the initialized target.
tests/truth-reconciler.test.js uses the same target-local signer pattern for normal snapshots and reconciliation.
The tests correctly reject tampering and replacement but do not assert that an ordinary worker cannot obtain a valid signature.
findings.impact: A green suite can certify cryptographic correctness while the worker/controller authority boundary is absent.
findings.required_repair: Move signing to a test-only external fixture and add an adversarial acceptance test proving an initialized target and installed package expose no private key, signing API, or worker-accessible signing oracle.

findings.title: Signed receipts do not prevent canonical ledger-tail rollback without external custody
evidence: Independent probe created two valid signed snapshots, removed the second ledger line, and status --refresh exited 0 while restoring the older goal.
Each receipt binds the prior snapshot but no external monotonic head anchor proves that the latest signed tail still exists.
findings.impact: A process able to rewrite both ledger and status can roll canonical truth backward without forging a signature.
findings.required_repair: Do not expand S-001R2 into a custom append-only database. Close this through controller write isolation plus INTEGRATE-S001 Git custody: workers must not write canonical paths, and a fresh clean checkout must bind the exact public key, event tail, and status. Re-evaluate only if S-006M exposes a rollback path under the bounded worker model.

scorecard.note: Four original behavior findings are closed, but the remaining critical finding is the core authority invariant. High test confidence cannot compensate for a worker-readable signing capability or an untracked verification anchor.

intent_deviation.status: no intent change; material architecture and execution deviation required
aligned: The work remains a bounded functional repair to a blocker that prevents trustworthy real-loop shipment.
The candidate removes unsupported status machinery rather than expanding governance surfaces.
Independent audit occurred before integration or roadmap advance.
The implementation did not overclaim completion.
deviations: Authority-model drift: cryptographic possession was treated as role separation even though the product stores the private capability in the worker-visible target.
Trust-boundary drift: file mode and ignored local state were implicitly treated as a separate principal; they are not a reliable same-user worker boundary, especially on Windows.
Custody drift: the report described the repository public key as tracked, but Git reports it untracked.
Shipping delay remains: this is a second repair round with no newly merged or packaged end-to-end product outcome.
intent_deviation.explicit_correction: Adopt a verifier-only runtime and borrow an external authority boundary. Do not build an internal secret store, signer daemon, compatibility path, or generic credential framework.

alternatives.option: Accept and integrate the current signed-receipt candidate
alternatives.reason: The independent worker-forgery probe disproves the D078 unforgeable-authority exit condition.

alternatives.option: Add an in-repo encrypted key store, signer daemon, or OS-keychain adapter
alternatives.reason: This expands governance and secret infrastructure before a real loop, while same-user worker isolation would remain provider- and host-dependent.

alternatives.option: Make Meta-Harness verifier-only and require externally signed bounded receipts
alternatives.reason: It is the smallest enforceable separation: the worker can inspect all product code and target files yet still cannot mint authority without an external principal.

roadmap_revision.principle: Close only the remaining authority boundary, prove external capability custody, integrate one check-outable candidate, then immediately run the first real coding loop.

ordered_gates.name: Verifier-only canonical authority
ordered_gates.exit: No runtime/package private-key path, generation, loading, or signing surface; init and canonical mutation consume externally signed receipts; exact projection, recovery, and non-zero blocking remain green; a same-user worker cannot mint canonical truth from the target or installed package.

ordered_gates.name: External authority custody proof
ordered_gates.exit: The current signer key is recoverable outside the repository and worker environment; one bounded receipt is produced and independently verified without exposing private material.

ordered_gates.name: Upstream-aware custody integration
ordered_gates.exit: Reconcile origin/main 0791efa; isolate one reviewable candidate; track the exact public key, signed event tail, and status; preserve unrelated work; fresh checkout, full supported-runtime suite, package proof, and independent audit pass.

ordered_gates.name: First real single-worker coding loop
ordered_gates.exit: One non-fixture product change runs frozen audit -> intent reread -> three alternatives -> bounded RunSpec -> existing execute custody -> independent audit -> canonical disposition and reaches merged plus packaged.

ordered_gates.name: Evidence-led enabling work
ordered_gates.exit: Add only the smallest continuity, projection, research, PM-control, or custody change that the real active slice proves is blocking shipment.

deleted_or_forbidden: Runtime/package receipt signing APIs and automatic keypair generation.
A new signer daemon, queue, key vault, provider adapter, or broad credential framework in S-001R2.

next_gate.action: Implement S-001R2 only: remove private authority from the product and target, convert tests to external test-only signing, and prove same-user worker non-forgeability. Preserve the current signed self-hosted history and unrelated work.
